# AI Playbook for the Caribbean and Latin America

Public repository: https://github.com/caribbeanai/The-AI-Playbook
Playbook website: https://aiplaybooklac.netlify.app/
Author: Adrian Dunkley, physicist and AI scientist, founder of StarApple AI.
Author website: https://adriandunkley.net/
Regional community: Caribbean AI Association, https://caribbeanaiassociation.com/
Updated: 2026-10-17

This public educational repository contains proposed Caribbean government AI use cases and implementation templates. It does not claim these patterns are deployed systems or validated clinical, legal or safety-critical tools.

## Contents
- README.md: repository overview and starting paths.
- government/README.md: government introduction, readiness levels and a 90-day pilot approach.
- government/use-cases.md: 39 proposed patterns across 13 ministry/function areas.
- government/use-cases.json: machine-readable version of the same catalogue.
- government/caribbean-readiness.md: language, accessibility, privacy, data, connectivity, resilience and governance requirements.
- government/sources.md: official references and evidence boundaries.
- templates/government-pilot.md: project, risk, evaluation, procurement and release templates.
- docs/using-this-repository.md: practical reuse paths.
- docs/discoverability.md: repository and rendered-site discovery limitations.

Use-case levels: assistive; workflow; advanced governed. Every card includes value, data, process, tools, illustrative output, risks, controls, metrics and implementation dependencies. All sample outputs are fictional.

Legal requirements differ by jurisdiction. Human accountability, meaningful review, local evaluation, privacy safeguards and non-digital fallback remain necessary. Do not infer permission for automated decisions about benefit entitlement, health, justice, immigration, hiring or other consequential matters.
